## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 6-fascicle text is the *short* / *pre-Niè-pán* (*Ní huán* 泥洹) recension of the *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra*, brought back from India by [法顯](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E9%A1%AF) Fǎxiǎn (337–422) on his great pilgrimage and translated into Chinese in collaboration with [佛陀跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%99%80%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) Buddhabhadra at the Dàochǎngsì 道場寺 in Jiànkāng. This shorter recension predated the full Dharmakṣema *Northern Recension* (*Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 [KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001), T0374, 40 fasc.) by some years and was the basis for the *Pre-Niè-pán*-school doctrinal controversies of [竺道生](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E9%81%93%E7%94%9F) Dàoshēng's generation.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (416–418) reflects Fǎxiǎn's translation activity at the Dàochǎngsì.

The Taishō text (T0376) is established on a particularly rich apparatus.
